_comment: Non-clinical, configurable interpretation framework. Bands are PROPOSED from the dataset's own quartiles (bottom quarter / middle half / top quarter), NOT from any reference document. Set approved=true only after the project owner reviews them.

bands.label: Signal: strained
bands.text: Your estimate is in the lower quarter of students in the training data. Small shifts in sleep, screen time or stress can go a long way.

bands.label: Signal: balanced
bands.text: Your estimate is in the middle range of students in the training data, with some room to recover and reset.

bands.label: Signal: strong
bands.text: Your estimate is in the upper quarter of students in the training data. Your habits look well supported - keep it up.

disclaimer: This is an informational, non-clinical estimate based on habits. It is not a diagnosis or medical advice. If you're struggling, please talk to someone you trust or a qualified professional.
